instruction:
You are checking `SSC-18-LH-02`, a task-owned synthetic stormwater or treatment telemetry control package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Telemetry, control narrative, communications, and backup-power workflows shape the context only; this instance does not parse real PLC, SCADA, telemetry, or authority-approved records.

Source pack:

- Sensor schedule: `SENSOR-18-SCHED-02`
- Level/flow table: `LEVEL-18-TABLE-02`
- Control narrative: `NARR-18-CTRL-02`
- Communications topology: `COMMS-18-TOPO-02`
- Power schedule: `PWR-18-SCHED-02`
- Telemetry memo: `MEMO-18-TEL-02`

Given values:

| Field | Value |
| --- | ---: |
| Current level | {{ current_level_m }} m |
| Level range | {{ lower_range_level_m }} to {{ upper_range_level_m }} m |
| High level alarm | {{ high_level_alarm_m }} m |
| Pump start/stop | {{ pump_start_level_m }} / {{ pump_stop_level_m }} m |
| Sensor accuracy | {{ sensor_accuracy_pct_span }} percent of span |
| Telemetry devices | {{ device_count }} at {{ device_power_w }} W |
| Radio power | {{ radio_power_w }} W |
| Backup duration | {{ backup_duration_h }} h |
| Battery | {{ battery_voltage_v }} V, {{ battery_capacity_ah }} Ah, usable fraction {{ battery_usable_fraction }} |
| Inverter efficiency | {{ inverter_efficiency }} |

Required calculations:

- Level span equals upper range minus lower range.
- 4-20 mA signal equals `4 + 16 x (level - lower range) / level span`.
- Sensor accuracy in metres equals level span times accuracy percent divided by 100.
- Telemetry load equals device count times device power plus radio power.
- Backup energy required equals telemetry load times duration divided by inverter efficiency.
- Battery usable energy equals voltage times Ah times usable fraction.

Return one JSON object with keys:

```json
{
  "level_span_m": <numeric_value>,
  "current_signal_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "high_level_current_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "pump_start_current_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "pump_stop_current_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "sensor_accuracy_m": <numeric_value>,
  "pump_start_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "telemetry_load_w": <numeric_value>,
  "backup_energy_required_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_usable_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "backup_energy_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, PLC/SCADA export validity, executable real source-pack parsing, full standards compliance, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "stormwater-treatment-telemetry-control-package"
description = "SSC-18 stormwater/treatment telemetry scaling, control, communications, and backup metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound telemetry control metrics from a deterministic SSC-18 task-owned source pack. The template combines level transmitter 4-20 mA scaling, pump setpoint currents, communications load, battery backup energy, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "telemetry-control"
standards = ["ISA-5", "SCADA telemetry workflow", "control narrative workflow"]
tags = ["electrical", "instrumentation", "telemetry", "controls", "4-20ma", "backup-power", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.current_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "LEVEL-18-TABLE-02 current stormwater/treatment level"
min = 3.2
max = 3.2

[params.lower_range_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SENSOR-18-SCHED-02 level transmitter lower range"
min = 0.0
max = 0.0

[params.upper_range_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SENSOR-18-SCHED-02 level transmitter upper range"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.high_level_alarm_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "NARR-18-CTRL-02 high-level alarm setpoint"
min = 4.2
max = 4.2

[params.pump_start_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "NARR-18-CTRL-02 pump start setpoint"
min = 3.5
max = 3.5

[params.pump_stop_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "NARR-18-CTRL-02 pump stop setpoint"
min = 1.2
max = 1.2

[params.sensor_accuracy_pct_span]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "SENSOR-18-SCHED-02 transmitter accuracy as percent of span"
min = 0.25
max = 0.25

[params.device_count]
type = "float"
description = "COMMS-18-TOPO-02 telemetry device count"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.device_power_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "PWR-18-SCHED-02 power per telemetry device"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.radio_power_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "COMMS-18-TOPO-02 radio power"
min = 35.0
max = 35.0

[params.backup_duration_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "PWR-18-SCHED-02 required backup duration"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.battery_voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "PWR-18-SCHED-02 battery voltage"
min = 24.0
max = 24.0

[params.battery_capacity_ah]
type = "float"
unit = "Ah"
description = "PWR-18-SCHED-02 battery capacity"
min = 120.0
max = 120.0

[params.battery_usable_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "PWR-18-SCHED-02 usable battery fraction"
min = 0.8
max = 0.8

[params.inverter_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "PWR-18-SCHED-02 inverter efficiency"
min = 0.9
max = 0.9

[outputs.level_span_m]
description = "Transmitter level span"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.current_signal_ma]
description = "4-20 mA signal at the current level"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.high_level_current_ma]
description = "4-20 mA signal at the high-level alarm setpoint"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pump_start_current_ma]
description = "4-20 mA signal at the pump-start setpoint"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pump_stop_current_ma]
description = "4-20 mA signal at the pump-stop setpoint"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.sensor_accuracy_m]
description = "Sensor accuracy converted to metres"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pump_start_margin_m]
description = "Pump-start level minus current level"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.telemetry_load_w]
description = "Total telemetry load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.backup_energy_required_kwh]
description = "Backup energy required"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.battery_usable_kwh]
description = "Usable battery energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.backup_energy_margin_kwh]
description = "Usable battery energy minus required energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "Pass score for telemetry control checks"
tolerance = 0.03
